units.source_text: 朱雀院闻前斋宫将入宫为冷泉帝女御，心中十分惋惜。

en.t: When Emperor Suzaku heard that the former Ise priestess was to enter the palace as a consort of Emperor Reizei, he felt deep regret.

units.source_text: 但深恐外人说长道短，绝不和她通信。

en.t: But because he greatly feared gossip from outsiders, he never exchanged letters with her.

units.source_text: 只是到了入宫那一天，遣使致送许多名贵礼品到六条宫邸中去。

en.t: Only on the day she entered the palace did he send a messenger to deliver many precious gifts to the Rokujo residence.

units.source_text: 其中有华丽无比的衣服，有世间难得的梳具箱、假发箱、香壶箱，还有种种名香，

en.t: Among them were incomparably splendid robes, rare comb cases, wig boxes, incense jar boxes, and many kinds of fine incense,

units.source_text: 就中熏衣香尤为稀罕，乃精工调制之珍品，百步之外亦能闻得香气。

en.t: and among these, the incense for perfuming robes was especially rare, a treasure skillfully blended so that its fragrance could be smelled even a hundred paces away.

units.source_text: 大约预料源氏内大臣会看到这些礼品，所以早就用心准备，故意装潢得特别触目。

en.t: He had probably foreseen that Minister Genji would see these gifts, so he had prepared them with care in advance and deliberately made their presentation especially striking.

units.source_text: 正好源氏内大臣来了，侍女长就将此事奉告，并请观看礼品。

en.t: Just then Minister Genji arrived, and the chief lady-in-waiting reported the matter to him and invited him to view the gifts.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣一看梳具箱的箱盖，便觉精美绝伦，可知是名贵物品。

en.t: As soon as Minister Genji saw the lid of the comb case, he found it exquisitely made beyond compare and knew it was a precious object.

units.source_text: 在一个装栉的小盒的盒盖上装饰着沉香木做的花朵，但见那上面题着一首诗：

en.t: On the lid of a small box for holding combs, flowers made of aloeswood had been arranged, and on it a poem was inscribed:
